name: Blood Sins
storyline:
Enter the realm of Harda, a kingdom that has flourished under the rule of the Houser family for centuries. But now, its peace is under threat. The corruption seeping out from Wick has cast a dark shadow over the land. The kingdom's soldiers have managed to contain the spread of these malevolent beings, but containment is not enough. What Harda needs is a hero – someone who can confront and eliminate the source of this chaos.

The exact nature of how Amrak invaded the kingdom remains shrouded in mystery. Unraveling these enigmas is one of the many challenges you, as our hero, must face. In your quest, you are not alone. You will be aided by a cast of unique characters: Jahnarr the blacksmith, Maugh the merchant, and Gonel the scholar. Each one plays a crucial role in supporting you on your mission.

In this epic journey, you will navigate through a world teeming with danger and intrigue. Your decisions and actions will determine the fate of Harda. Prepare to embark on a quest filled with intense battles, challenging puzzles, and a story that unfolds based on your choices. Can you restore peace to the kingdom and unveil the truth behind Amrak's invasion?
summary: Embark on a heroic quest in Harda, a kingdom threatened by dark forces from Wick. Unravel the mystery of Amrak's invasion, aided by allies like Jahnarr, Maugh, and Gonel. Your choices shape the fate of the realm. Can you restore peace to Harda?
